info.name: Get A List Of Field Extraction Rules.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of field extraction rules returned in the response. The number of field extraction rules returned may be less than the `limit`.

params.name: token
params.description: Continuation token to get the next page of results. A page object with the next continuation token is returned in the response body. Subsequent GET requests should specify the continuation token to get the next page of results.

items.docs: Get a list of all field extraction rules. The response is paginated with a default limit of 100 field extraction rules per page.

info.name: Create A New Field Extraction Rule.

items.docs: Create a new field extraction rule.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of field extraction rule to return.

items.docs: Get a field extraction rule with the given identifier.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the field extraction rule to update.

items.docs: Update an existing field extraction rule. All properties specified in the request are replaced. Missing properties are set to their default values.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the field extraction rule to delete.

items.docs: Delete a field extraction rule with the given identifier.
